claims.claim: Plastic drum for storage of any kind of liquid
claims.evidence: No interior view, no food-grade or chemical-safety marking legible in photo 0 or photo 1; staining suggests prior industrial/chemical use which could restrict safe liquid types.

risks.risk: Unknown prior contents could mean chemical residue, making drum unsafe for food or potable water storage.
risks.proof: Close-up interior photo and a clear shot of any hazard/content label on the drum.
risks.if_unproven: priced as industrial-use-only, not food/water safe

risks.risk: Exact drum capacity (e.g., 200L vs 210L vs smaller) cannot be confirmed from stacked wide shots.
risks.proof: Clear photo of embossed liter marking or a tape-measure shot of height/diameter.
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest common standard size seen in such lots

risks.risk: Structural condition (cracks, warping, leaks) cannot be assessed from a distance in a crowded stack.
risks.proof: Video or photo of a single drum filled with water showing no leaks, plus close shots of seams and base.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not leak-tested / possible defects

risks.risk: Cap/bung seal integrity unknown, affecting usability for liquid storage.
risks.proof: Close-up of the bung cap and threads showing it seals properly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as seal unverified, assume needs replacement

risks.risk: Listing shows many drums in bulk; unclear if price is per unit or per lot.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation of per-unit vs bulk pricing with a count.
risks.if_unproven: priced per single unit, worst case

proof_requests: Close-up photo of one drum's embossed capacity marking and any manufacturer label.
Interior photo of an empty drum to check for residue or damage.
Close-up of the bung cap/seal area.
A water-fill or tilt test video showing no leaks.
Confirmation of whether the price is per single drum or for a bulk lot.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used blue plastic storage drum, so it can be priced at its worst case (unverified food-safety, unconfirmed capacity, untested for leaks) pending the listed proofs.
